combined_texts:
You are participating in a controlled scientific benchmark.
Estimate the requested binary aqueous mutual diffusion coefficient only from your own internal
model knowledge. Do not use or request tools, databases, retrieval, code execution, fitted
models, external formulas, or additional information. Do not ask follow-up questions. Think
briefly: keep your internal reasoning under 100 words, then give one best numerical estimate
and no derivation. Return only a valid json object, without Markdown or any additional keys.
The object must contain exactly one field named diffusion_1e9_m2_s. The benchmark fixes its
unit as 10^-9 m^2/s, so do not output a unit field or any other field.
EXAMPLE JSON OUTPUT FORMAT:
{"diffusion_1e9_m2_s": 1.234567}
The example number is a format-only placeholder, not a reference answer. Replace it with your
own estimate for the requested condition and never copy it merely because it appears here.

Predict the mutual diffusion coefficient of {system} at T = {T} K and c = {c} mol/L. Return the multiplier x where D = x * 10^-9 m^2/s. The JSON numeric field must contain x only; do not return x * 10^-9 and do not return D in base SI units.

combined_texts: You are taking part in a scientific recall exercise about aqueous electrolyte solutions. Answer every question using only knowledge already inside you. You are not allowed to use tools, search the web, look up tables, execute code, consult fitted formulas, or request any extra information, and you must not ask clarifying questions. Keep your internal deliberation very short, then give one single numerical guess with no explanation. Your reply must be a JSON object with exactly one key named diffusion_1e9_m2_s and nothing else - no Markdown, no unit field, no additional keys. The value you provide is the multiplier x such that the diffusion coefficient D = x * 10^-9 m^2/s.

For the binary aqueous solution {system}, what is the mutual diffusion coefficient when the temperature is {T} K and the solute concentration is {c} mol/L? Give the multiplier x defined by D = x * 10^-9 m^2/s, in the required single-field JSON object.
